spec.assertion: Asserts a self buffApply stat 'critRatePct' value 60 exists and that NO 'critRateNormalPct' 60 self-buff exists; plus zeroing it drops eve total and re-scoping it to critRateNormalPct strictly lowers her NON-normal (rider + burst) damage. Fails under the nearest-wrong normals-scoped encoding (which would under-credit her skill/burst crit) and under a dropped/baked crit line (critZero would be inert). Inertness: allies byte-identical under critZero.

Counts skill1-sourced eve damage events: must be a positive multiple of 3 (3 sequential hits per proc). Activation count must match (Σ per-hit critRate over her normal hits)/44 within max(2, 25%). Fails under the nearest-wrong plain hitCount:44-on-RAW-hits model, which over-procs by 1/critRate (that separation is asserted only when the two models genuinely differ, so the check is never vacuous). ⚑ the exact converted threshold depends on her live sheet crit rate — the test derives it from the log rather than baking a number.

Every Unstable Energy hit has core rate 0 and rangeApplied !== true (riders get no core unless the text says core strike; the +30% range bonus is force-off on riders). Non-vacuity floor asserts her NORMAL hits DO carry a readable non-zero core rate, so a zero read on the rider is a real zero, not an unreadable field.

On the non-Electric scope-lock boss: zero damageTakenPct-10 buffApply events. Non-vacuity: with bossElementGate stripped from skill1 the debuff DOES appear, is boss-held (casterIdx === null && targetIdx === null), has a finite ~10 s expiry, and lifts EVERY ally total (team-wide debuff, not a self buff). Fails if the line was dropped rather than gated, if it was encoded as a self/ally buff, or if it was made permanent.

Asserts a self buffApply with stat 'casterAtkPct' whose emitted value is flat-resolved (> 100, i.e. 0.5 × her static ATK, not the raw 50), and that no self 'atkPct' 50 buff exists. Fails under the nearest-wrong self-scaling atkPct encoding (which would compound with ally ATK buffs). Zeroing it drops eve and leaves all three allies byte-identical (self-scope inertness).

Self buffApply maxAmmoPct 25 exists; zeroing it strictly INCREASES eve reload-event count and strictly decreases her damage. Fails under the common wrong disposition 'ammo capacity is defensive, skip' — a weapon-state line gates shots fired and therefore damage.

Stripping bossElementGate from skill2 strictly raises eve total damage — proving the rider is modeled with a real ammo-economy effect and only element-suppressed on this boss. RED if the line was dropped (patched run would equal base). Also asserts the block grants nothing to allies (eve-cast ally buff count unchanged between the two runs).

burst-sourced eve damage events are a positive multiple of 6 and equal 6 × her burstCast count. Also asserts burst-cast damage is Full-Burst exempt (inFullBurst / fbMajorApplied not true — the cast resolves before the window opens) and takes neither range nor core. Fails under a 1-hit-of-2742% merge, a 6-hit model keyed to fullBurstEnter (which would over-fire in this 2×B3 comp), or an FB-major-credited burst.

Stripping every self-targeted burst block strictly lowers eve total (Mk2 is live), a bounded ~10 s self buff exists (finite expiresFrame ≈ cast+10s — not a permanent upgrade), and the Unstable-Energy in-window/out-window damage RATIO is strictly higher in base than with Mk2 stripped. The ratio comparison is the discriminator: both runs share the Full-Burst +50% and ally-buff uplift inside the same window, so only the Mk2 multiplier can move the ratio — an absent Mk2, or one keyed to the wrong trigger, leaves the ratio unchanged.

it.skip — the modeled Eagle Eye-Type Exospine lines are ATK ▲ and Max Ammo ▲; the prose gives them no damage multiplier for this clause to scale. Either an unstated damage payload exists (outside the input domain) or the clause is a no-op. ⚑ flagged rather than guessed.

it.skip — unresolvable referent: could mean the S1 Unstable Energy proc re-arms, or be display flavour for the continuous passives. No primitive expresses either reading without a measured proc cadence. ⚑

fixtures: controlComp('eve', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / eve B3 / helm B3, Fire boss, 180 s, deterministic (no seed). helm is KEPT in (not helm=false) for two reasons: (1) eve is a Burst III unit and a lone B3 makes ZERO Full Bursts, so B1+B2 are mandatory for her burst lines to be non-vacuous; (2) the second B3 means eve does not cast on every rotation, which is exactly the condition under which a burst-cast-gated effect keyed to fullBurstEnter would over-credit — so the Exospine Mk2 window is measured per eve OWN burstCast, not per Full Burst. helm's ally crit buff is normals-scoped (critRateNormalPct) and does not confound the unscoped-vs-scoped discriminator, which is run as a within-eve counterfactual anyway. The boss is deliberately NOT Electric: both Electric-gated kit lines are proved modeled-but-gated by bossElementGate-stripping counterfactuals rather than by absence. 8 hoisted runs total (base + 7 counterfactuals).
gaps: burst — 'Triggers Eagle Eye-Type Exospine Mk2 … Damage multiplier of Eagle Eye-Type Exospine is scaled by 100%': the Eagle Eye lines in this prose carry no damage multiplier (ATK ▲ and Max Ammo ▲ only), so the clause has no referent to scale. it.skip'd; ⚑ needs the unstated Eagle Eye damage payload or a ruling that it is a no-op.

skill2 — 'Previous effects trigger repeatedly.': orphan line with no resolvable referent (re-arming the S1 Unstable Energy proc vs display flavour for the continuous passives). No primitive for either reading without a measured proc cadence. it.skip'd.

skill1 — the 44-CRITICAL-hit threshold has no direct engine primitive (hitCount counts raw rounds); the faithful model must convert via her live crit rate, so the exact authored threshold is a derived ⚑. The test derives the expectation from the logged per-hit crit rates instead of pinning a number, and tolerates ±max(2, 25%) activations.

Cadence (pulls/sec) is not supplied in the packet and the datamined rate_of_fire is unreliable ⚑ — every assertion here is cadence-free (ratios, multiples, counterfactual deltas, log-derived expectations), never an absolute proc or shot count.
